notes: §1985:X.3.1.3 SR1: the PROGRAM-ID program-name of a (nested) program 'must conform to the rules for formation of a user-defined word' (§1985:IV.4.2.2.1: at most 30 characters of letters, digits and hyphen, hyphen not at an edge). programIdParagraph takes programName (cobolWord), the same funnel as the end marker: ParseArm.VisitCobolWord (30-char ceiling COBOL1567, reserved word COBOL0901), WordCharacterScreen.CheckWord (underscore/extended letter COBOL0900 below 2002), CharacterViolation (edge hyphen COBOL2773). Probes at --std 85 on a contained program (classes b, c): MY_SUB COBOL0900 (accepted at 2023), ADD COBOL0901, SUB- COBOL2773, 999 and "SUBL" COBOL5506, a 33-char name COBOL1567, the 2002 AS literal phrase COBOL0900; S-2 IS COMMON PROGRAM runs. The witness BADNAME- is refused with COBOL2773.

next.reason: 1985: the nested PROGRAM-ID program-name 'must conform to the rules for formation of a user-defined word' (§1985:IV.4.2.2.1: 'not more than 30 characters', letters, digits, hyphen). 2023: program-name-1 of §2023:11.10.2 is a user-defined word under §2023:8.3.2.1 SR1 and §2023:8.3.2.2 SR3, but §2023:8.3.2.1 widens the word to 'not more than 63 characters' and adds 'extended letters' and the 'underscore'. PROGRAM-ID. MY_SUB. in a contained program is refused by the 1985 rule and accepted by 2023. The changed text is the uncatalogued 8.3.2.1 general paragraph (kb/Work PB479); the AS literal-1 phrase is separate new syntax.
